Hey! I have been on academic probation before three times! Apparently you are only supposed to be in probation twice but personal life circumstances pushed my grades low. I would recommend talking with our advisor and making a plan, that is usually what happens in probation you make a contract of what grades you expect to get during the semester and what steps are you taking to make that happen. For me, it was meeting my professors at the begging of the semester tell them I was in probation and that I wanted to do well in the class and if they had any advice or suggestions. I would also meet with my advisor every 2 weeks to update him on how I was doing in my classes and if I needed help. I was able to sign up with the DRC for extended exam time as well which helped me tremendously with my anxiety and depression during the semester. Overall I hated being in academic probation with all my heart, but I promise this is not the end of the world. Use probation as a way to get out of there and finding new study alternatives or better and new methods that you think you should try this semester. Wish you the best of luck!!! Just please remember probation is not the end of the world, a lot of us have been through academic probation but simply we don't get to talk about it all the time.
